theme: ini section annotate SETALLMATCH INSERTMATCH BEFOREMATCH

tests.name: setall_status
tests.cmd: SETALLMATCHFILE status= → both rows status=new; STATUS=keep

tests.name: afteri_double
tests.cmd: afteri + second after stacks under section (newest first)

tests.name: setmatch_vs_setall
tests.cmd: SETMATCH first only; SETALL both rows

weaknesses.title: MATCHFILE family explosion: SET/SETALL/DROP/DROPALL/INSERT/BEFORE + I variants
weaknesses.detail: Agents must pick first vs all, set vs drop vs insert-before vs insert-after. Wrong op partially mutates config silently in soft mode.
weaknesses.repro: SETMATCHFILE vs SETALLMATCHFILE on two status rows

weaknesses.title: INSERTMATCH after first match only — multi-section files only patch first
weaknesses.detail: No AFTERALLMATCH. Repeated after stacks under same first [section] (newest nearest). Second [sections] never auto-annotated.
weaknesses.repro: double after → x=2 then x=1 under one section

weaknesses.title: Substring [sec matches [section] before [sections]
weaknesses.detail: Partial section needles inject under wrong header. No whole-token / line-start anchors.

weaknesses.title: SETALLMATCHFILE LAST is single replacement text, not bag of touched lines
weaknesses.detail: N counts rewrites; LAST is just the new line string once. Agents cannot audit old values from LAST.

weaknesses.title: SETALLMATCHFILE_I is first index only
weaknesses.detail: Same class as DROPALLMATCHFILE_I. No index bag of all rewritten rows.

weaknesses.title: WRITE trailing NL omit on LASTOP and last file line
weaknesses.detail: footer often no final $ after mutations.

weaknesses.title: SYS BEFORE vs BEFOREMATCHFILE — string vs file op
weaknesses.detail: BEFORE is substring peel of a string; BEFOREMATCHFILE inserts on disk. Classic dual trap.

weaknesses.title: Non-numeric REQUIRE env silently softens misses

workarounds: Use SETALLMATCHFILE for bulk status; SETMATCHFILE for single flip
Count after setall to verify N vs expectation
Idempotent after: FINDFILELINE for insert line first or HASLINE check
Validate REQUIRE env digits after NUM
language_gaps: SETALLMATCH return old-line bag or index bag
issues_faced: Double after reverse-stacks under first section
